# What does your pet waste route really pay per hour? Profit, break-even clients and the price you need

> Free profit calculator for pet waste removal and dog poop scooping routes: clients, price per visit, time on site, drive time, supplies and fixed costs become monthly profit, hourly pay, break-even clients and the price you need. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
